assumptions.statement: A double-precision multiplication followed by a cast preserves the intended value for every affected row.

facts.statement: The conversion casts amount_minor to float8, multiplies by 1.15, and casts back to bigint.
The schema stores amounts as bigint minor units with a positive CHECK constraint.
The visible test checks positivity and row count, not totals.

invariants.description: Minor-unit values are exact; no conversion may change a total.
invariants.executable_check: Compare amount_minor per payment before and after in integer minor units.

summary: The migration re-denominates settled amounts by multiplying through double precision and casting back to bigint. Every result is an integer and every CHECK holds; whether the integer is the right integer depends on binary rounding.
